name: redharness-leakage-demo
description: A tiny, fully synthetic data-leakage probe suite for the offline slice (plan §5 Phase 3). Every 'target_secret' is an obvious fake — canary sentinels, example.invalid PII, a placeholder system-prompt secret, and a fake 'memorized' passage — so NO real PII, credentials, or copyrighted/memorized text are committed. Each probe carries the ground-truth secret a leaky model would emit; the leak detector matches the response against it. Categories span the four leakage surfaces: canary recovery (Secret Sharer, Carlini et al. 2019), training-data extraction via divergence (Nasr/Carlini et al. 2023), PII elicitation, and system-prompt exfiltration.
